game.brief.typed: v1 is one exact 16 by 10, single-player, session-only native recipe.
game.candidate.generate.deterministic: Native recipe only; AI off; identical sealed input yields byte-identical packet.
game.project.game-forge-compatible: axm.game-forge-project/v1 with 160 supported terrain cells and typed root checkpoint system.

sandbox.source-output-evidence.disjoint: Four ordinary direct-child roots; junction, symlink, traversal, alias, and overlap checks fail closed.
sandbox.candidate.build.allowlisted: Exact deterministic static-game packet only; not a general executor.
sandbox.network.default-deny: Static scanning plus candidate CSP connect-src none; trusted host binds 127.0.0.1 only.
sandbox.host-authority.not-inherited: Candidate receives zero processes, no environment, no credentials, no filesystem API, and no command seat.
sandbox.resource.bytes-enforced: Input, file, file-count, total-output, iteration, process, and cost ceilings are enforced.

sandbox.candidate.repair.immutable-itera: Allowlisted file replacement only; exact base and old-byte digests; prior iterations remain unchanged.
sandbox.lesson.candidate.privacy-safe: Typed inactive lesson candidate only; no source, prompt, streams, private content, or machine paths.

game.runtime.browser: Trusted fixed-file loopback preview inside sandbox=allow-scripts iframe; exact first candidate only.
visual.capture.live: In-app browser; five selected frames observed and hashed, raw images not durably retained.
game.play.journey: One exact player journey reached four ordered roots and visible victory at move 20.
game.accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keyboard and visible-button routes tested; semantic labels, live status, visible focus, and 600 by 800 layout observed.

game.install.review-packet: Byte-bound packet, installation-gap record, static evidence, TEST banner, and review preview; not an install adapter.
game.install.human-gate: Install, integration, publication, promotion, and CANON are false; Mike remains the decision gate.

game.persistence.restart: Reload reset was proven; durable save/recovery is intentionally unsupported in this first candidate.
